gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Approachable letters with short ascenders and a tall x-height sit under Tourney, a display face drawn at a single stroke width. Make that heading small and its stretched tracking and bulky lowercase lose their punch, while Noto Sans Tai Viet stays friendly.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-takri: Tourney is cut with one unchanging stroke width, stretched out by wide tracking and packed with oversized lowercase. Noto Sans Takri is the plain sans that follows, its round letters left generously unclosed.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified even at modest sizes, its terminals stopping well away from the stem. Yet Tourney up top is the louder one, a display face with bulky lowercase and a line like a plotter pen.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplemen: Contemporary and clean, the body text here has round forms like open parentheses beneath Tourney, whose pencil-like strokes never press harder. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has such a tall middle band that lines look stocky, which gives the wide-tracked heading a sturdy partner on the page.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Chunky, sporty, and stretched wide. Tourney does the shouting with its rounded-wire strokes and oversized lowercase, while Noto Sans Tangsa, a sans-serif with short ascender stems and inviting round openings, does the quiet work of carrying the text.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tc: Approachable and wide open, Noto Sans TC sits below a heading cut like rope. Tourney is made for making a loud, tracked-out statement, and the sans body is made for the large open counters that keep text easy going.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Rope-thick, wide, and sporty: that is Tourney, with bulky lowercase and tracking pulled far apart. But Noto Sans Telugu is the better text face, with a high-set midline and sans counters that stay connected to the outside.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-thai: One steady stroke thickness runs through all of Tourney, with bulky lowercase and wide tracking. Noto Sans Thai below it is swollen like inflated glass beads, its rounded letters left open, so a long passage feels soft and approachable.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Tourney looks drawn with a single pen tip, wide-tracked and stuffed with oversized lowercase. It is made for impact, while Noto Sans Thai Looped, a sans-serif, handles text with spacious curve terminals.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Clean and open, Noto Sans Tifinagh fills the line with inflated lowercase bowls beneath Tourney, whose curves have the heft of a rope's body. A longer passage in this sans-serif would feel inviting and smooth, with rounded letters that never crowd the eye.
